notes: Date filter on the Cycle Price History browser. Range chips (24H / 7D / 30D / ALL) plus From/To date pickers; the view now defaults to the last 7 days instead of the full archive, so opening a ticker no longer loads months of rows. ALL still shows the full ~5-month window. Filtering happens server-side, so only the requested range is sent. Carries 1.1.8.7 and earlier.
